quote.text: The Sage desires only one thing, virtue, and he is cautious about only one thing, vice. He is the same in every circumstance because what is most important lies within him, and not with external events, which are constantly changing.
quote.author: Donald J. Robertson
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace virtue as a guiding principle in nurturing your children, teaching them that what is truly important comes from the character within rather than the ever-changing circumstances of life.
    • Cultivate a home environment where virtues such as honesty and integrity flourish, creating a steady source of resilience for your family in the face of unpredictability.
  • Leadership:
    • Lead by example, remembering that your inner commitment to virtue is what sets the standard for others, regardless of external challenges or fluctuations in circumstance.
    • Exercise caution towards vice and inconsistency, reinforcing that true leadership is not swayed by the transient nature of events but is anchored in steadfast moral principles.
  • Product Management:
    • Apply the wisdom of prioritizing intrinsic worth over external trends; a product built on robust, ethical foundations stands stronger amid changing market dynamics.
    • Maintain consistency in your vision and decision-making by focusing on the essential virtues of transparency and reliability, ensuring that the product’s integrity remains unshaken by external pressures.
